import sys


def main():
    jobs = []
    for line in sys.stdin:
        parts = line.strip().split()
        if parts:
            name, arrival, duration, priority = parts
            jobs.append((name, int(arrival), int(duration), int(priority)))
    jobs.sort(key=lambda j: (-j[3], j[1], j[0]))
    time = 0
    idle = 0
    job_ptr = 0
    while job_ptr < len(jobs):
        current_job = jobs[job_ptr]
        if current_job[1] > time:
            idle += current_job[1] - time
            time = current_job[1]
        name, arrival, duration, priority = current_job
        print(name, time, time + duration)
        time += duration
        job_ptr += 1
    print("idle", idle)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
